provenance.blocks: two-window blocks (2j, 2j + 1), j = 0..31, in window_ids order
provenance.eligibility_rule: F12a.4(b),(e): a donor is used iff its original `eligible` flag is the boolean true and all 64 windows are masked in with finite centred noise; the flag is read from the source and never derived from finiteness; a missing or non-boolean flag fails extraction closed
provenance.not_read: donor_mean and every other field: skipped undecoded by the top-level scanner
